html_bullets.point: Infosys is expected to see inflows of $85 million due to its increased weightage in the MSCI Standard Index.
Infosys is included in the top five stock holdings for both FIIs and DIIs, with FIIs holding 30.3 billion and DIIs holding 26 billion.

Infosys reported an 11.7% decline in net profit to 7,033 crore for Q4 FY25, attributed to increased selling and marketing expenses, despite a revenue growth of 7.9% to 40,925 crore. The company also predicted weaker-than-expected revenue growth for FY26.
Infosys saw substantial EPS cuts in April 2025, contributing to the overall downgrades in the IT services sector.
Infosys reported a revenue growth of 3.85% in FY25, which is lower compared to mid-cap IT companies.
Infosys guided for revenue growth of 0-3% in constant currency for FY26, reflecting a cautious outlook amid global economic uncertainties.
Infosys plans to hire over 20,000 freshers in FY26 and has started rolling out wage hikes from January, with the remainder effective from April 1.
Infosys added 9,442 employees in FY25, trailing behind mid-cap competitors in hiring rates.
Infosys has informed employees that their performance bonuses for Q4 FY25 will be lower due to declining profits.
Infosys announced a three-year strategic partnership with the Lawn Tennis Association (LTA) to enhance the HSBC Championships at Queen's Club, utilizing its AI-powered Infosys Topaz technology.
Infosys and the International Tennis Hall of Fame extended their collaboration until 2028, focusing on digital innovations and AI to enhance fan engagement in tennis.
Infosys, in collaboration with Economist Impact, launched The Sustainability Atlas, an AI-powered tool designed to provide businesses with sustainability-focused insights.
Infosys Limited has announced the voluntary liquidation of its wholly owned subsidiary, In-tech Automotive Engineering de R.L. de C.V, which reported no revenue or net worth as of March 31, 2025.

Infosys Limited has received a penalty of CAD 21,416.76 from the Canada Revenue Agency for alleged short payment of tax related to payroll trust audits for the years 2017 to 2024. The company stated that there is no material impact on its financials or operations.
Infosys Limited will participate in a Non-Deal Roadshow on May 15, 2025, featuring group and one-on-one meetings in a virtual format with Ganesh Ramasubramanian, AVP – Investor Relations.
Infosys is part of the group of IT giants that have opened new campuses in Hyderabad, enhancing the state's reputation as a center for technology and investment.
